title: Daily 5, Thu 26 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: The 11 players in a cricket team have an average age of 26 years. When the coach is included, the average age goes up by 1 year. How old is the coach?
A sum lent at compound interest, compounded annually, amounts to ₹6,050 after 2 years and ₹6,655 after 3 years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
10 workers, working 8 hours a day, finish a job in 15 days. How many days will 12 workers need for the same job if they work 5 hours a day at the same rate?
The roots of x² − 8x + 12 = 0 are α and β. Find 1/α + 1/β.
A student needs 40% of the maximum marks to pass. She scores 72 marks and misses the pass mark by 16. What are the maximum marks?
